# Collective

> Collective is an independent growth business led by David Collins. Collective connects strategy, acquisition, conversion and operations around the commercial priorities of your business.

Every article is written by David Collins, founder and director of Collective: https://wearecollective.com.au/about/david-collins

## Articles

- [The shape of an independent growth business](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/independent-growth-business): Why Collective connects commercial judgement, delivery and operating capability around the decisions a business needs to make.
- [How to diagnose marketing performance before changing strategy](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/diagnose-marketing-performance): Separate channel health, conversion and sales outcomes to identify where marketing performance is breaking and what to examine next.
- [Pipeline velocity: what it measures and what it misses](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/pipeline-velocity): Calculate pipeline velocity, interpret its four inputs and understand why modelled revenue pace is different from profit or cash flow.
- [When revenue grows and profit doesn’t](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/revenue-and-profit): A practical way to examine the cost, customer mix and delivery decisions behind a growing revenue number.
- [Understanding ecommerce commercial performance](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/understanding-ecommerce-commercial-performance): How revenue, contribution, profit, customer economics and cash connect in ecommerce. The order in which to read an executive dashboard.
- [Revenue, contribution and operating profit](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/revenue-contribution-and-operating-profit): How net revenue becomes gross profit, contribution and operating profit. Why profit dollars and margins are read together, with an example month.
- [Reading monthly and year-on-year performance](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/reading-monthly-and-year-on-year-performance): How to choose a comparison period for ecommerce results. Dollars, percentages and percentage points, and combined ratios from the totals.
- [MER, ROAS and profitable growth](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/mer-roas-and-profitable-growth): How MER and ROAS differ, and how efficiency relates to contribution and profit. How to test assumptions about spending more on media.
- [Customer acquisition cost, customer value and payback](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/customer-acquisition-cost-value-and-payback): Business media CAC, allowable CAC, contribution lifetime value and payback. How cohorts show when acquisition cost is recovered.
- [Cash, inventory and the pace of growth](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/cash-inventory-and-the-pace-of-growth): Why profit and cash follow different timing. How to read a cash forecast by date, stock cover and the reserve that limits growth.
- [Ecommerce performance glossary](https://wearecollective.com.au/insights/ecommerce-performance-glossary): Definitions and calculations for the measures in the Commercial Performance series. Revenue, contribution, profit, MER, ROAS, CAC, LTV, payback and cash.

- [David Collins, founder and director](https://wearecollective.com.au/about/david-collins): David Collins is the founder and director of Collective and the author of its articles. His experience, recognition and every article he has written for Collective.

- [Property developer founding partnership](https://wearecollective.com.au/developer-partnership): A partnership for property developers building a business and brand across projects.
- [Let’s talk](https://wearecollective.com.au/contact): Start a conversation with David Collins about your business, the opportunity and what you would like to change.
